title: [review] confirm GET /deaddrop unauthenticated enumeration is by-design (spec 12) and note it in spec
description: P3. GET /deaddrop is unauthenticated while POST is OSCORE/admin-gated. Content is OSCORE-E2E-encrypted so blob data is safe, but any mesh peer can enumerate ?node= targets and observe queue existence/size/timing metadata. Reviewer notes spec/12-apps.md appears to intend open GET retrieval. Confirm design intent; if intended, add one sentence to the spec chapter documenting the metadata-exposure tradeoff; if not, gate GET.
